fallhaven_pot_antifoodp2.m: Oh yes, I have a recipe for a mixture that helps against food poisoning. If you want, I could create some of that for you.
r: Sounds good, what do you need from me?

fallhaven_pot_antifoodp3.m: I am all out of the ingredients required for it. Maybe you could help me gather some of them?
r: No way, I'm not running your errands.

fallhaven_pot_antifoodp4.m: Fair enough. Welcome back if you change your mind.

fallhaven_pot_antifoodp5.m: To make the potion against food-poisoning, I would need one poison gland and two pieces of animal hair. I will also require 50 gold for the work required.
r: I'll be right back with those ingredients.
Any ideas where I can find those ingredients?
I have those ingredients for you.
I have those ingredients for you.
Here, I have enough of those ingredients for five potions.
Here, I have enough of those ingredients for ten potions.

fallhaven_pot_antifoodp7.m: Well, animal hair can probably be found on any beast here outside of Fallhaven. I heard some hunters found a pack of wolves a bit south of here.

fallhaven_pot_antifoodp8.m: Poison glands however, can be a bit trickier to find. I don't know really, but any poisonous creature might do. Maybe some snakes around here are poisonous?
r: I'll be right back with those ingredients.
Phew, that sounds like a lot of work. I don't know if I'll do it.

fallhaven_pot_antifp_q1.m: Good. Give me a minute to prepare that antidote for you.

fallhaven_pot_antifp_q3.m: There. One potion against food-poisoning for you.

fallhaven_pot_antifp_q3x10.m: There. Ten potions against food-poisoning for you.

fallhaven_pot_antifp_q3x5.m: There. Five potions against food-poisoning for you.

fallhaven_pot_antifp_q4.m: I can create more of those potions if you want. You'll have to bring me more of those ingredients then.
r: I sure hope this mixture of your works.

fallhaven_potions.m: Welcome to my shop. Please browse my fine selection of everyday potions.
r: Let me see what potions you have available.
Do you have anything to help against food-poisoning?
I was told that I can get some Spotted Hornbeam fungus from you.
Can you sell me a special crystal vial?
Bogsten is sick after encountering a giant mushroom. He asked me to get a cure for him.
Here are four samples of mushroom spores. Can you help Bogsten now?
Here's a sample of the mushroom spores. Can you help Bogsten now?
Here are some of Bogsten's mushrooms.

fallhaven_potions2.m: Oh yes. Really disgusting smell, they have. But good for making potions.

fallhaven_potions3.m: Here, have some. I don't have that much, so don't lose it!

fallhaven_potions4.m: I already gave you some, before. Don't tell me you lost it?

fallhaven_potions_buy_crystal_vial.m: Here is your crystal vial. Thanks for the 50 gold pieces.

fallhaven_potions_offer_crystal_vial.m: Yes, I have some crystal vials. I can sell you one for 50 gold pieces.
r: That is too expensive for me.

fungi_panic_potioner_10.m: Bogsten? I haven't heard from that old boy in a long time now. I was starting to wonder if he was still alive.
r: He is alive, but only barely. He didn't even make it to Fallhaven to ask for help.
Stop talking. Just give me the cure.
Hey! Aren't you going to give me something interesting for it?

fungi_panic_potioner_110.m: I could, yes. But I won't.
r: That's robbery! I won't let you get away with it!

fungi_panic_potioner_111.m: Well, what did you expect? I make potions, not mushroom stew. If that's what you're after, go look for that Gison fellow south of town.

fungi_panic_potioner_112.m: Now leave my shop, unless you have some other business. I have work to do.
r: Forget it, let's talk about something else.
You can't do that to me! I'll get the guards!

fungi_panic_potioner_120.m: Calm down. Shall I sell a sedative to you?
r: NO! I DON'T NEED ANY SEDATIVE!!

fungi_panic_potioner_20.m: And now I have to rescue him again. Well, what did he do to himself this time?
r: This time? Did he ask for help before?

fungi_panic_potioner_22.m: Several times, indeed. Let me think...

fungi_panic_potioner_24.m: He was my first customer. Needed an antidote against snake poison. His pet snake bit him.
r: I heard enough. Just give me the cure, please.

fungi_panic_potioner_26.m: Next time he ate something interesting. I always had told him not to try all these red and white mushrooms.

fungi_panic_potioner_28.m: Then he wanted some drink for an annoying 'friend' who always came and disturbed him.
r: Enough. Just give me the cure, please.

fungi_panic_potioner_30.m: He came regularly for the snake antidote. Trying to tame snakes wasn't successful obviously...

fungi_panic_potioner_32.m: He even tried to get my recipe for this antidote. But of course I couldn't reveal it to him.
r: Yes, such things should be done by learned potion makers.

fungi_panic_potioner_34.m: Nonsense. He was my best customer. I want to keep it like this.

fungi_panic_potioner_40.m: So you need a cure against giant mushrooms?
r: Yes. Here are some samples of the mushroom spores.

fungi_panic_potioner_42.m: There are lots of different mushrooms. A spore infection can be nasty, deadly even. Unfortunately the cure for one kind kills you, when you are afflicted by another kind.
r: Oh dear. So Bogsten can't be helped?

fungi_panic_potioner_44.m: No need to despair. To make a cure, I will need a sample of these spores. Can you get some?

fungi_panic_potioner_46.m: Good. Bring me four sample spores of the mushroom, then I will be able to choose the right antidote.
r: I will be back with the spores in an instant.
Here are four samples of the mushroom spores.

fungi_panic_potioner_50.m: Let me see... Ah, yes. A fungus maximus, also known as 'Giant mushroom'. Its wounds are deadly if not cured properly.

fungi_panic_potioner_50a.m: A sample? This won't do. I'll need at least four samples for my work.
r: I see. I'll be back with more in just a moment.

fungi_panic_potioner_52.m: I'm glad that I have the right potion for it. You can have it for only 150 gold coins.

fungi_panic_potioner_54.m: Take it or leave it. Poor Bogsten ...

quick_glance.10: I talked to Anakis. He told me that his sister, Juttarka, went into the cave and did not come out again.
quick_glance.15: I denied to help Anakis to find his sister, Juttarka.
quick_glance.20: I agreed to help Anakis find his sister, Juttarka.
quick_glance.40: I found a stone statue that looked almost like a real woman.
quick_glance.50: I told Anakis about the statue. He thinks that it is his sister, Juttarka, and thanked me for helping him.
quick_glance.60: Anakis asked me if I could avenge his sister.
quick_glance.70: I agreed to avenge Anakis' sister, Juttarka, and kill the Basilisk.
quick_glance.75: I should talk to Fangwurm, the priest of west Brimhaven, to see if he has some information about how it may be possible to help Anakis' sister.
quick_glance.77: Fangwurm told me that the Basilisk's blood has special properties. It can protect against damage if applied to the skin. Fresh, warm, Basilisk's blood might even be able to heal a person that has been turned to stone.
quick_glance.78: The priest Fangwurm told me that the potion maker in Fallhaven sells special crystal vials that are resistent to the blood of a Basilisk, and I will need one to handle it.
quick_glance.79: I should search the other rooms in this cave for a mirror that I can use to protect me from the glance of the Basilisk.
quick_glance.85: I saved the life of Anakis' sister Juttarka.
quick_glance.90: I told Anakis that I killed the Basilisk.

fungi_panic.10: I met old man Bogsten in his cabin. He was sick after encountering a giant mushroom and wanted me to go see the potion merchant in Fallhaven to get a cure.
fungi_panic.20: The potion merchant needed four spore samples to prepare the cure. I should go back to see Bogsten.
fungi_panic.30: Bogsten gave me the key to his backyard. I should go to the mushroom cave from there and collect the spore samples.
fungi_panic.40: I showed Bogsten the spores. Now I should go back to see the potion merchant.
fungi_panic.50: The potion merchant gave me the cure. I should give it to Bogsten now.
fungi_panic.60: Bogsten said evil forces in his cave were preventing him from working. He asked me to check his cave and gave me his necklace.
fungi_panic.70: I met an old sorcerer named Zuul'khan in the cave. He told me Bogsten's family imprisoned him using an ancient petrifying spell, but thanks to Bogsten's laxity, he was now free.
fungi_panic.72: He wanted me to kill Bogsten and bring him Bogsten's staff.
fungi_panic.90: I defeated Zuul'khan, but he was not dead. He disappeared into the ground.
fungi_panic.92: I told Bogsten about what happened.
fungi_panic.100: Bogsten remembered the petrifying spell. This time he would make sure that Zuul'khan cannot come back. He gave me a bag of mushrooms and told me I should take them to the potion merchant.
fungi_panic.102: Zuul'khan seems to have moved away from Bogsten's caves to another hiding place.
fungi_panic.110: The potion merchant said that these were very rare mushrooms. He prepared two "Underground Fighter" potions for me. He would sell me some more if I came back.
fungi_panic.115: Zuul'khan's offer seemed interesting. I have to go kill Bogsten.
fungi_panic.135: I decided to keep Bogsten's staff for myself, so I had to kill Zuul'khan.
fungi_panic.145: I defeated Zuul'khan, but he was not dead. He disappeared into the ground.
fungi_panic.150: I gave Bogsten's staff to Zuul'khan.
fungi_panic.155: He rewarded me with permanent immunity to Spore Infection.
fungi_panic.161: I got through the black fog.
fungi_panic.162: I got through the black fog again after a fight with Zuul'khan.
fungi_panic.164: After another fight with Zuul'khan I got through the black fog again.
fungi_panic.169: I overpowered Zuul'khan one more time, but this time the black fog wouldn't go away. Obviously I can't get past the fog that way.
fungi_panic.170: I defeated Zuul'khan one last time and the black fog was gone for good. I must find and destroy the fungi leader.
fungi_panic.200: I defeated the giant mushroom, Zuul'khan's fungi leader.
fungi_panic.210: A young girl named Lediofa emerged after my battle with the mushroom. She told me how Zuul'khan captured her as food for the mushroom. She seemed to have been poisoned just like Bogsten, so I directed her to see the Fallhaven potioner.
fungi_panic.220: I met Lediofa at the potions shop in Fallhaven. She couldn't afford to pay the potioner for a mushroom poison cure, so I gave her the gold she needed. In return, she offered her family's hospitality if I ever come to visit in Nor City.

antifoodp.10: I should visit the potion-maker in Fallhaven and ask for something to help against food poisoning.
antifoodp.15: The potion-maker in Fallhaven can create potions that help against food-poisoning.
antifoodp.20: I should bring him a poison gland, two pieces of animal hair and 50 gold pieces, and he'll create a potion for me.
antifoodp.30: I have brought the ingredients for the potion.
antifoodp.35: I received a potion of antidote, that should help me if I get food-poisoning.
antifoodp.40: I can bring him more ingredients if I want him to create more antidote potions in the future.

lodar_pots.10: Lodar says that he can make potions from some animal remains, if I first bring him some Spotted Hornbeam fungus. Apparently, the potion-maker in Fallhaven has a stock of it, if you know enough to ask.
lodar_pots.20: I have retrieved some Spotted Hornbeam fungus from the potion-maker in Fallhaven. I should return to Lodar with it as soon as possible.
lodar_pots.30: I have given the Spotted Hornbeam fungus to Lodar.
lodar_pots.40: Lodar thanked me for bringing him the fungus. In return, he can now create his special potions for me.
lodar_pots.41: Lodar can create a defensive potion if I bring him two White wyrm claws and a Ruby gem.
lodar_pots.42: Lodar can create a potion of strength if I bring him a dead spider and the wings of an insect.
lodar_pots.43: Lodar can create a potent defensive potion if I bring him two arulir skins and a claw from some monster. The arulir beasts can be found somewhere up in the north, and the claws can apparently be found from creatures that dwell underground and in caves somewhere outside Fallhaven.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
